resources.string: Today\'s day of the year, to compare with the pack date on an egg carton
The 3-digit number printed on the carton
Pack dates run from 001 to 365 (366 in leap years)

Cartons from USDA-inspected plants show a 3-digit pack date: the day of the year the eggs were washed, graded and packed. January 1 is 001 and December 31 is 365. Compare it with today\'s number to see how long ago the eggs were packed.
USDA advises keeping eggs refrigerated and using them within 3 to 5 weeks of buying them.
